head.text: PATHOLOGICAL -- in_order (SCHED_POLICY.order_mode=1). Every entry is eligible and several are page hits, but only the HEAD may issue, so a row-interleaved stream pays PRE+ACT between consecutive columns while the hit sits two entries back. This is the cost of the mode, not a defect: it exists to make ordering observable. Roughly 17x on the board -- use it to prove reordering is what is buying the bandwidth, never in production.
